Resolves #21512

Related: #21329 · #21178 · #6914

Restores natural `<input>` intrinsic sizing and container stretch on `Neo.form.field.ComboBox` and its subclasses (`Country`, `Chip`, `Color`), and pins `width: 150` on the one consumer (`examples/tableFiltering/MainContainer.mjs`) whose HTML `<table>` column auto-layout relied on the retired default:
- **`resources/css/src/form/field/ComboBox.css`:** Keeps `.neo-textfield-input:not(.neo-typeahead-input)` in normal flow inside `.neo-input-field-wrapper` (`display: flex; flex: 1 1 auto; min-width: 0; position: relative`) while only `.neo-typeahead-input` uses `position: absolute; inset: 0; pointer-events: none`.
- **`src/form/field/ComboBox.mjs`:** Removes the legacy `width: 150` default (`#6914`, added when both inputs were out of flow).
- **`examples/tableFiltering/MainContainer.mjs`:** Pins `width: 150` on the `Country` header filter `ComboBox` (`editorConfig`) so HTML `<table>` auto-sizing keeps the `Country` column `164 px` wide (`"United Kingdom"` single-line).
- **`test/playwright/component/form/field/ComboBox.spec.mjs`:** Browser component test mounting un-sized `TextField`, `ComboBox` (`left` and `inline`), and `Country` (`showFlags: true`) inside an `align: 'start'` `Neo.container.Base` alongside an explicitly constrained `width: 120` `ComboBox`.

Ticket intake (`#21512`, self-authored): drift probe against `origin/dev` since `2026-11-19T20:16Z` returned zero intersection; Stage-2 prescription checked against `ComboBox.css`, `ComboBox.mjs`, and `get_class_hierarchy` (`Country`, `Chip`, `Color`).

Evidence: L3 (browser component spec `ComboBox.spec.mjs` green locally and red on `dev` base; `build-themes` green across all themes; 31-file consumer census + `1440 × 900` whole-page before/after pairs across all published un-sized consumer surfaces below) → L3 required (AC-1..AC-4).

agent-preflight: not hosted here; baseline `PR baseline` and `Commit authorship` run in CI.
